craft_notes: Sthāyin: day-night doctrine. Rows: glow-melt-sameness. Read aloud: even tread.

lines: Knowable's glow is day; its melt in the melter, night;
they — glow and rest, quick-slow, in endless else, in sameness still.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra vedyamayatāprakāśo dinaṃ vedyasya vicārayitari layo rātriḥ te ca prakāśaviśrāntī cirāciravaicitryāt anantabhede tatsāmye tu viṣuvat
